purpose: Make the evidence required to rival frontier systems explicit. Missing tracks stay missing; a good result on one track does not qualify another.

implemented.metric: Original-choice accuracy by all six skills; zero-shot direct decisions
implemented.comparison_caveat: No leaderboard submission or official multimodal-gain/leakage audit; pretrained contamination unknown
Mono 16kHz input; exact dataset revision recorded; no hidden 9000-case evaluation submission

implemented.metric: Zero-shot direct-answer accuracy; Jev and OpenAI use identical source questions/options
implemented.comparison_caveat: Not the full 12032-question few-shot CoT score

implemented.metric: Nine-region classification accuracy. The fixed grid-center click control has a zero oracle ceiling and cannot measure grounding quality.
implemented.comparison_caveat: Precise GUI grounding remains unmeasured. All 117 target boxes are unreachable from the nine allowed click points; see reports/v4-iteration-v2/grounding-action-space-audit.json.

implemented.coverage: Five observations; 1, 4 and 16 questions; five timed repetitions
implemented.metric: Full file-to-probability latency, encoder call counts, numerical and order agreement
implemented.comparison_caveat: Warm single H100; no network, queue or deployment SLA

required_but_not_yet_measured.requirement: Pin original multi-image/vision-only variants, original choices, full test scope and scoring; retain unsupported modes
Preserve duration, multi-audio and spatial cues; no silent 30s clipping, ASR substitution or stereo collapse
Original free-answer ANLS and relaxed numeric accuracy; never construct multiple-choice distractors using the hidden answer; add scanned and multipage PDF tests
Actual XLSX/PDF upload-to-result tests with tables, formulas, page boundaries, corruption and unsupported file types; transport acceptance is not model understanding
Obtain complete versioned cases, executable workflow, reference distributions and official scorer; selected webpage examples are not a representative export
required_but_not_yet_measured.label_caveat: Published accuracy measures agreement with model consensus, not independently adjudicated correctness
required_but_not_yet_measured.status: Complete official artifacts not located in inspected public links

required_but_not_yet_measured.requirement: Same agent harness, tool budget and task reset; original executable final-state success; pinned VM/site release; evaluate in isolated benchmark environments
Human speech referring to real screen/document content; counterfactual media swaps, contradictions, missing modalities and distractors; private fresh holdout
Full-workflow success, ranking NDCG/pair accuracy, schema validity, calibration and confidence-based escalation, long context and changing candidate counts
Paired client-visible p50/p95/p99, cold starts, concurrency, throughput, all retries and media ingestion, actual allocated-resource cost per correct completed task

claim_policy: Frontier parity is scoped to an explicitly named task distribution, model version, inference budget and confidence interval.
Compare both maximum-quality frontier configurations and latency-oriented configurations; disabling competitor reasoning alone does not establish frontier capability parity.
For direct-answer latency comparisons, publish output limits and truncation failures; do not suppress failed or expensive cases.
Keep API end-to-end latency separate from local GPU pipeline time. Same-hardware comparison is possible only among accessible open weights.
After evaluation results guide a design change, use a newly frozen confirmation set for the next claimed gain.
Teacher and competitor outputs are evaluation references only in this study, not automatically authorized training data.
